description: Catalogue and docs for the whole A2 / Active Oberon module world — the bundled standard library (std/*) and installable community packages (community/*, via `ob get`).

apps/desktop.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
apps/desktop.summary: The desktop's own programs and tools: viewers and players, the editors and converters, the inspectors and monitors, the installers, and what draws the desktop itself.

apps/perfmon.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
apps/perfmon.summary: The performance monitor: the application, its tabs and components, the alert machinery, and a plugin per thing worth watching -- CPU, memory, heap, disks, network, processes, messages, module variables, the servers.

attic/activecells-hardware.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
attic/activecells-hardware.summary: The hardware synthesis back end for ActiveCells: cells and ports turned into an FPGA design rather than into code.

attic/activecells-sharp.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
attic/activecells-sharp.summary: ActiveCells# -- a C#-flavoured syntax over the ActiveCells model, from Alexey Gokhberg's parser.

attic/arm32.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
attic/arm32.summary: The 32-bit ARM back end, assembler and disassembler.

attic/interpreter.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
attic/interpreter.summary: An interpreting back end: runs the intermediate code instead of generating machine code.

attic/legacy-services.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
attic/legacy-services.summary: Network services of another era, kept because they are in the tree and they work: a Fidonet client and a stock-quote server.

attic/oberon2.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
attic/oberon2.summary: The Oberon-2 compiler of the old system, and the Minos object format and linker beside it.

attic/sr-voxel.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
attic/sr-voxel.summary: The sr voxel and ray engine: volume textures, ray casting, the voxel spaces and the demos over them.

attic/subversion.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
attic/subversion.summary: A Subversion client over WebDAV/DeltaV: the HTTP authentication, the XML of the DeltaV methods, the working-copy bookkeeping and the command line above them.

attic/tf-tools.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
attic/tf-tools.summary: Thomas Frey's own semantic tooling for Active Oberon: a type system and scope tools independent of the Fox front end, and the checker over them.

attic/trm.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
attic/trm.summary: Back end for the Tiny Register Machine.

community/ar.summary: Unix ar archives (the container inside a .deb): read and write.

community/matrix.summary: Dense/complex linear algebra, ML, wavelets, PDE, statistics (Hunziker). Headless numeric core.

community/octk.summary: OCTK compute toolkit. Remeasured 2026-08-24 against the SDK payload of that day (340 modules, HostLibs and Out included): still 0 of 77. The chain bottoms out inside the package -- octkBase needs octkErrorBase, which needs the 32-bit I386.octk*Optimized kernels and FFI to AMD CAL GPU compute. Needs a 32-bit target and a GPU binding, not a package of ours.

community/opendocument.summary: OpenDocument (ODF) codecs. Remeasured 2026-08-24: 0 of 4. XMLSignatures needs WMDialogs (std/gui) and everything else here imports XMLSignatures, so the whole package waits on the graphical package -- plus OpenDocumentTransforms is still a malformed XSL-as-source.

community/ph.summary: PH utilities (IP monitor, registries, web syndication). Remeasured 2026-08-24: what blocks it is no longer missing std packages -- NewHTTPClient is in the payload now. PHRegistries fails on its own source ('step value of incompatible type', the older array dialect) and PHUserRegistry and PHWebSyndication follow it out; IPMonitor imports WSock32, so it is Windows-only. Fix the one module and three of four compile.

community/reanimator.summary: A JVM implemented in A2 (JVM*/jjl* = java.lang). Remeasured 2026-08-24: 1 of 42, unchanged. It asks for the names of the old system -- PCDebug, AosKernel, AosOut, AosProcessors -- so it needs an Aos* compatibility shim before anything else.

community/sr.summary: sr voxel/raytracer engine. Remeasured 2026-08-24: 0 of 22. srBase needs Raster (std/gui) and DbgOut, which is in no tree we have. The sources are also in minia2 (attic/sr-voxel), which is how every module there stays claimed.

community/v4l2.summary: Video4Linux2 capture bindings (V4L2 + libv4l2 FFI, Linux). Installable; ob doc hangs on these modules — docs deferred.

community/work.summary: Grab-bag of experiments and tools. Remeasured 2026-08-24: 6 of 81 compile against the payload -- BASS and BassSound (FFI to the native BASS audio library, a second road to sound beside std/sound), Containers, PascalPreprocessor, ReflectionTools and its test. The rest needs the window system or names that no longer exist. Triage before packaging still stands, but those six are a package's worth.

std/archive.summary: ZIP container formats: archive reader/writer, zip-backed file system, zip CLI tool, standalone unzip.

std/base.summary: The library that needs no host: strings and their pool, streams and number conversion, dates, bit sets, options, locks, pipes, the plugin registry, and the small collections.

std/calc.summary: Numerical calculus: Gauss/Grünwald/Diethelm quadrature and differentiation kernels over std/math + std/numerics.

std/compiler.summary: The Active Oberon compiler: the Oberon front end, the semantic checker and syntax tree, the intermediate code and its textual form, the AMD64 and AArch64 back ends and assemblers, the linker, the disassembler, the documentation back end, and the language server.

std/compress.summary: DEFLATE/zlib primitives (inflate + deflate, buffers, stream readers/writers) and gzip. Container formats (ZIP) live in std/archive.

std/crypto.summary: Ciphers (AES/DES/Blowfish/CAST/IDEA/Twofish/ARC4), hashes (MD5/SHA1/SHA256/SHA3/Keccak), public-key (RSA/DSA/DH), big numbers, CSPRNG (Fortuna), ASN.1 / X.509.

std/data.summary: Data structures and persistence: generic collections/sort, lists/queues/stacks/trees, the Models/Repositories/Types object framework, CSV, persistent objects, versioning.

std/disk.summary: Block devices and the file systems on them: the disk and volume abstractions and their cache, FAT, ISO 9660, the old Oberon file system, partitions, a RAM volume, and file systems reached over a network.

std/drivers.summary: Low-level device drivers: display registry, serial ports (V24), keyboard/mouse, PC speaker, clipboard.

std/gui.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
std/gui.summary: The A2 graphics + window-manager framework as one irreducible unit: Raster/Gfx rendering, image codecs (PNG/JPEG/SVG/BMP), OpenType fonts, and the WM* component/desktop toolkit. Merged because graphics and the window manager are mutually dependent (see cycle note).

std/ime.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
std/ime.summary: Typing the world's scripts: the input-method framework and its methods -- Arabic, Armenian, Ethiopic, Hebrew, Pinyin, Russian, Ukrainian and a Unicode fallback -- with the language switcher, the Unicode character databases behind them and the Unihan parser.

std/math.summary: Numeric core: fixed/arbitrary number types (Nbr*), base real/complex math (Math, Math32/64/L), RNG. Advanced/special functions live in std/numerics.

std/media.install: in the tree, not in the SDK payload
std/media.summary: Audio/video/image codecs: MP3, DivX/MPEG video (+ IDCT, tables), WAV, GIF, AVI container, a codec registry and sound-device abstraction.

std/net.summary: Networking: TCP/UDP/IP/DNS/sockets, TLS, an HTTP client/server stack, and protocol clients (FTP, SMTP, POP3, SSH, TFTP, LPR, XModem).

std/numerics.summary: Advanced / special functions over the std/math number types: cube root, error/gamma functions, real & complex series, rational/real/integer numeric routines.

std/process.summary: Other programs on this machine: starting one with its input and output on pipes or with the terminal, waiting for it or killing it, reading the environment, and sockets named by a path -- the way a program is driven when a port would be the wrong thing.

std/runtime.summary: The closed kernel: what the compiler emits calls into without the programmer naming it, and what must exist before any module can load. Allocation and the collector, module loading and type descriptors, activities and AWAIT, the platform binding, the clock.

std/sound.summary: Sound out of this machine: the device abstraction, the cross-platform OpenAL driver behind it, and the Ogg/Vorbis decoder and stream player that reach a speaker without touching the codec registry.

std/system.summary: The host a program runs on: files, the trap handler and its stack traces, the dynamic loader and the object file it reads, the command interpreter and the standard streams, and what a process can say about itself.

std/terminal.summary: Full-screen terminal programs: what a terminal sends and understands, the terminal as a device, and Oberon's model of a screen drawn into it -- tiled frames of text with a caret, and any line runnable as a command.

std/text.summary: Rich text model and Unicode text utilities: the Texts piece-list model, TextUtilities (load/store/convert), UTF-8 helpers.

std/web.summary: XML stack (parser/scanner/DOM objects) and the Configuration settings module built on it.

notes.ocp_extras: a2oberon/ocp adds 33 modules not in A2Community (Rubik, VolumeRaytracer, Wedgelets, Miniscript, ants*, ...) — union candidates.
notes.binary_format: CONFIRMED harmless: ob compile/doc READ A2 binary Text format directly (Fox Text subsystem). OCTK/Reanimator/sr fail to build NOT because of the format but because of capability gaps: 32-bit (OCTK I386.*), GPU FFI (OCTK AMD CAL), legacy Aos* names + std/compiler (Reanimator JVM), std/gui (sr). Only our own grep/python text analysis is blocked by the format; use ob doc / .SymUu interface dumps to inspect these instead.
notes.platform_prefixed: Files like Unix.V4L2.Mod carry a [Platform.] filename prefix; the module inside is V4L2. Packaging must resolve the module name from the MODULE header, not the filename stem.
notes.embedded_excluded: a2oberon/ARM (73 modules: Enet stack, DMA330, Zynq EMAC) is a bare-metal/embedded track, not a library — excluded.
